# Status bar (`status-bar`)

Bottom bar with status items.

Group: Layout & shells. Styles: `import '@mosaic-home/design-system/css/layout';` (or `style.css`).

## Web API

`createStatusBar` (types in `dist/web/layout/statusBar.d.ts`): `.mh-status-bar` (`--sticky`): a slim `footer` bar of status items in a `__start` and an `__end` group. Each `__item` (`--accent | --success | --warning | --danger`, `--interactive` when it is a button) has an `__icon`, a `__label` and a mono `__value`.

```ts
export function createStatusBar(options: StatusBarOptions): StatusBarHandle;

export interface StatusBarOptions {
  /** Accessible name (default "Status"). */
  label?: string;
  items: readonly StatusBarItem[];
  /** Pins the bar to the bottom of a positioned container (default: in flow). */
  sticky?: boolean;
}

export interface StatusBarHandle {
  el: HTMLElement;
  /** Changes one item in place (label, value, icon, tone, title). */
  setItem(id: string, patch: Partial<Omit<StatusBarItem, 'id' | 'end' | 'onClick' | 'announce'>>): void;
}

export interface StatusBarItem {
  id: string;
  /** Visible text ("Connected", "3 updates"). */
  label: string;
  /** A value after the label, in the mono face ("21.5°", "14:02"). */
  value?: string;
  icon?: IconName | string;
  tone?: StatusBarTone;
  /** A fuller description, as a tooltip and the accessible description. */
  title?: string;
  /** Sits at the far end of the bar. */
  end?: boolean;
  /** Screen readers hear changes to this item (`aria-live="polite"`). */
  announce?: boolean;
  /** The item becomes a button. */
  onClick?: (event: MouseEvent) => void;
}
```

## Web example

```ts
import { createStatusBar } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

const now = () => new Date().toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' });

const bar = createStatusBar({
  label: 'Hub status',
  items: [
    { id: 'net', label: 'Connected', icon: 'wifi', tone: 'success' },
    { id: 'devices', label: 'Devices', value: '24' },
    { id: 'time', label: 'Synced', value: now(), end: true, announce: true },
    {
      id: 'sync',
      label: 'Sync now',
      icon: 'refresh',
      end: true,
      onClick: () => bar.setItem('time', { value: now() }),
    },
  ],
});

document.body.append(bar.el);
```

## React example

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { StatusBar } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/react';

const now = () => new Date().toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' });

export function StatusBarExample() {
  const [synced, setSynced] = useState(now);
  return (
    <StatusBar
      label="Hub status"
      items={[
        { id: 'net', label: 'Connected', icon: 'wifi', tone: 'success' },
        { id: 'devices', label: 'Devices', value: '24' },
        { id: 'time', label: 'Synced', value: synced, end: true, announce: true },
        { id: 'sync', label: 'Sync now', icon: 'refresh', end: true, onClick: () => setSynced(now()) },
      ]}
    />
  );
}
```
